@CODEBASE_OVERVIEW.md I'd like to add an additional scan mode for only detecting todos that were added in the current Git branch. This scan mode will need to...

1. Run `git diff main..HEAD`, and save the results somewhere (either in a buffer or on disk).

2. Do regex search (via ripgrep if we save to disk) on the resulting patch. Find only tags in the added lines.

3. If there is no branch named main, fall back to a branch named master.

Configuration (&#96;config.js&#96;)\n\nCentralized access to all settings:\n- General: tags, schemes, status bar, debug\n- Filtering: globs, workspaces, scan mode\n- Highlights: default/custom highlights, colour scheme\n- Tree: view style, sorting, badges\n- Regex: pattern, case sensitivity, multiline\n- Ripgrep: path, args, buffer size\n\n---\n\n## Scan Modes\n\n| Mode | Description |\n|------|-------------|\n| &#96;workspace&#96; | Scan workspace + open files (default) |\n| &#96;workspace only&#96; | Scan workspace only |\n| &#96;open files&#96; | Scan only open files |\n| &#96;current file&#96; | Scan only the active file |\n\n---\n\n## Scan Modes Deep Dive: Ripgrep vs In-Memory Search\n\nA critical insight into how Todo Tree works is that **ripgrep is NOT always used**. The extension uses two completely different search strategies depending on the scan mode:\n\n| Scan Mode | Ripgrep (Disk) | In-Memory Regex | Source |\n|-----------|----------------|-----------------|--------|\n| &#96;workspace&#96; | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes | Files on disk + open document buffers |\n| &#96;workspace only&#96; | ✅ Yes | ❌ No | Files on disk only |\n| &#96;open files&#96; | ❌ No | ✅ Yes | Open document buffers only |\n| &#96;current file&#96; | ❌ No | ✅ Yes | Active editor buffer only |\n\n### Why Two Search Strategies?\n\n1. **Ripgrep** (&#96;ripgrep.js&#96;): Fast file system search using the &#96;rg&#96; binary. Searches files on disk. Used for workspace scanning.\n\n2. **In-Memory Regex** (&#96;refreshFile()&#96;): JavaScript regex executed against &#96;document.getText()&#96;. Searches the VS Code document buffer. Used for open files.\n\nThe in-memory approach is necessary because:\n- Open files may have unsaved changes not yet on disk\n- It provides real-time updates as you type\n- Files opened from remote sources may not be on the local filesystem\n\n---\n\n### The &#96;rebuild()&#96; Flow\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nrebuild()\n    │\n    ├─► searchList = getRootFolders()     // Custom root folder if configured\n    │\n    ├─► searchWorkspaces(searchList)       // Add workspace folders based on scan mode\n    │   │\n    │   └─► if (scanMode === 'workspace' || scanMode === 'workspace only')\n    │           searchList.push(workspaceFolders...)\n    │       else\n    │           // searchList stays empty - no ripgrep needed\n    │\n    ├─► iterateSearchList()                // Run ripgrep for each path\n    │   │\n    │   └─► if (searchList.length &gt; 0)\n    │           for each path: search(getOptions(path))  // ← RIPGREP\n    │       else\n    │           // Skip ripgrep entirely\n    │\n    └─► refreshOpenFiles()                 // Scan open document buffers\n        │\n        └─► if (scanMode !== 'workspace only')\n                for each openDocument: refreshFile(document)  // ← IN-MEMORY\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### How &#96;searchWorkspaces()&#96; Controls Ripgrep Usage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// extension.js lines 451-469\nfunction searchWorkspaces( searchList )\n{\n    var scanMode = config.scanMode();\n    \n    // ONLY add workspace folders for these two modes\n    if( scanMode === SCAN_MODE_WORKSPACE_AND_OPEN_FILES || \n        scanMode === SCAN_MODE_WORKSPACE_ONLY )\n    {\n        vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders.map( function( folder )\n        {\n            searchList.push( folder.uri.fsPath );\n        } );\n    }\n    // For 'open files' and 'current file' modes, searchList stays empty\n    // This means iterateSearchList() won't call ripgrep at all\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### How Ripgrep is Called (Workspace Scanning)\n\nWhen &#96;searchList&#96; has entries, &#96;iterateSearchList()&#96; calls &#96;search()&#96; for each path:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// extension.js lines 323-351\nfunction search( options )\n{\n    // Calls the ripgrep wrapper\n    return ripgrep.search( \"/\", options ).then( matches =&gt; {\n        matches.forEach( match =&gt; {\n            match.uri = vscode.Uri.file( match.fsPath );\n            searchResults.add( match );  // Store results\n        } );\n    } );\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe &#96;getOptions()&#96; function builds the ripgrep command options:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// extension.js lines 392-449\nfunction getOptions( filename )\n{\n    var options = {\n        regex: utils.getRegexSource(),      // The TODO regex pattern\n        rgPath: config.ripgrepPath(),       // Path to rg binary\n        globs: buildGlobsForRipgrep(...),   // Include/exclude patterns\n        filename: filename,                  // Directory/file to search\n        additional: '--max-columns=1000 --no-config',\n        multiline: hasNewlineInRegex || config.enableMultiLine\n    };\n    \n    if( config.includeHiddenFiles )  options.additional += ' --hidden ';\n    if( !config.regexCaseSensitive ) options.additional += ' -i ';\n    \n    return options;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe actual ripgrep command executed looks like:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nrg --no-messages --vimgrep -H --column --line-number --color never \\\n   --max-columns=1000 --no-config \\\n   -e \"(//|#|&lt;!--|;|/\\\\*|^)\\\\s*(TODO|FIXME|BUG)\" \\\n   -g \"!**/node_modules/*/**\" \\\n   /path/to/workspace\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### How In-Memory Search Works (Open Files)\n\nWhen scanning open files, &#96;refreshFile()&#96; uses JavaScript regex directly:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// extension.js lines 777-861\nfunction refreshFile( document )\n{\n    searchResults.remove( document.uri );  // Clear old results for this file\n    \n    // Get the document text from VS Code's buffer (may have unsaved changes)\n    var text = document.getText();\n    \n    // Build regex from same pattern used by ripgrep\n    var regex = utils.getRegexForEditorSearch( true );  // global flag\n    \n    var match;\n    while( ( match = regex.exec( text ) ) !== null )\n    {\n        var result = {\n            uri: document.uri,\n            line: position.line + 1,\n            column: position.character + 1,\n            match: lineText\n        };\n        \n        searchResults.add( result );\n    }\n    \n    addResultsToTree();\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe regex is built from the same configuration:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// utils.js\nfunction getRegexForEditorSearch( global )\n{\n    var flags = 'm';\n    if( global ) flags += 'g';\n    if( !caseSensitive ) flags += 'i';\n    if( multiLine ) flags += 's';\n    \n    // Same pattern as ripgrep: \"(//|#|&lt;!--|;|/\\\\*)\\\\s*(TODO|FIXME|BUG)\"\n    return RegExp( getRegexSource(), flags );\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### How &#96;refreshOpenFiles()&#96; Controls In-Memory Scanning\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// extension.js lines 471-480\nfunction refreshOpenFiles()\n{\n    // Skip for 'workspace only' mode - don't scan open files\n    if( config.scanMode() !== SCAN_MODE_WORKSPACE_ONLY )\n    {\n        Object.keys( openDocuments ).map( function( document )\n        {\n            refreshFile( openDocuments[ document ] );\n        } );\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe &#96;openDocuments&#96; object is populated by event handlers:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// When editor becomes active\nonDidChangeActiveTextEditor: function( editor ) {\n    openDocuments[ editor.document.uri.toString() ] = editor.document;\n}\n\n// When document is opened\nonDidOpenTextDocument: function( document ) {\n    openDocuments[ document.uri.toString() ] = document;\n}\n\n// When document is closed\nonDidCloseTextDocument: function( document ) {\n    delete openDocuments[ document.uri.toString() ];\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### Scan Mode Behavior Summary\n\n#### &#96;workspace&#96; (default)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. searchWorkspaces() → adds workspace folders to searchList\n2. iterateSearchList() → runs ripgrep on each workspace folder\n3. refreshOpenFiles() → runs in-memory regex on all open documents\n4. Results merged → tree updated\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### &#96;workspace only&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. searchWorkspaces() → adds workspace folders to searchList\n2. iterateSearchList() → runs ripgrep on each workspace folder\n3. refreshOpenFiles() → SKIPPED (scanMode check fails)\n4. Only disk results shown → tree updated\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### &#96;open files&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. searchWorkspaces() → searchList stays EMPTY (scanMode check fails)\n2. iterateSearchList() → SKIPPED (searchList is empty, no ripgrep)\n3. refreshOpenFiles() → runs in-memory regex on all open documents\n4. Only buffer results shown → tree updated\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### &#96;current file&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. searchWorkspaces() → searchList stays EMPTY\n2. iterateSearchList() → SKIPPED (no ripgrep)\n3. refreshOpenFiles() → runs in-memory regex on open documents\n4. refreshFile() → additional check: only process if document === activeTextEditor\n5. Only active file results → tree updated\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### Real-Time Updates\n\nFor open files, the extension also responds to document changes for live updates:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// extension.js\nonDidChangeTextDocument: function( e ) {\n    documentChanged( e.document );\n}\n\nfunction documentChanged( document ) {\n    // Trigger highlighting\n    highlights.triggerHighlight( editor );\n    \n    // Refresh tree (with debounce)\n    if( shouldRefreshFile() ) {\n        clearTimeout( fileRefreshTimeout );\n        fileRefreshTimeout = setTimeout( refreshFile, 500, document );\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis means:\n- **Workspace files**: Updated only on manual refresh or file save\n- **Open files**: Updated in real-time as you type (500ms debounce)\n\n---\n\n## Configuration Schema\n\nThe &#96;package.json&#96; defines extensive configuration under &#96;contributes.configuration&#96;:\n\n- **General**: &#96;todo-tree.general.*&#96; (tags, debug, status bar)\n- **Filtering**: &#96;todo-tree.filtering.*&#96; (globs, workspaces)\n- **Highlights**: &#96;todo-tree.highlights.*&#96; (colours, styles)\n- **Tree**: &#96;todo-tree.tree.*&#96; (view options, sorting)\n- **Regex**: &#96;todo-tree.regex.*&#96; (search pattern)\n- **Ripgrep**: &#96;todo-tree.ripgrep.*&#96; (binary path, args)\n\n---\n\n## Event Flow\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nUser Action           →   Event Handler         →   Result\n─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nOpen file             →   onDidOpenTextDocument →   refreshFile()\nEdit file             →   onDidChangeTextDocument → refreshFile() + highlight()\nSwitch editor         →   onDidChangeActiveTextEditor → highlight() + showInTree()\nSave file             →   onDidSaveTextDocument →   refreshFile()\nClose file            →   onDidCloseTextDocument →  remove from tree\nConfig change         →   onDidChangeConfiguration → rebuild() or refresh()\nClick tree item       →   revealInFile command  →   open file at line\nRefresh button        →   todo-tree.refresh     →   rebuild()\nFilter button         →   todo-tree.filter      →   provider.filter()\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Dependencies\n\n| Package | Purpose |\n|---------|---------|\n| &#96;@primer/octicons&#96; The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what was added:

### Files Modified:

**1. `src/extension.js`**
- Added `SCAN_MODE_GIT_BRANCH = 'git branch'` constant
- Added `getBaseBranch(workspaceFolder)` function that checks for `main` branch first, falls back to `master`
- Added `searchGitBranch(workspaceFolder)` function that:
  - Runs `git diff <base>..HEAD --unified=0`
  - Parses the unified diff output to find added lines (lines starting with `+`)
  - Extracts file paths from `+++ b/path` headers
  - Tracks line numbers from `@@ ... @@` hunk headers
  - Matches TODO regex against added content
  - Creates search results with proper file path, line number, and column
- Modified `rebuild()` to handle the new scan mode with a separate code path
- Added `scanGitBranch()` function to switch to the new scan mode
- Registered `todo-tree.scanGitBranch` command
- Updated status bar to show "(in git branch)" when in this mode

**2. `package.json`**
- Added `"git branch"` to the `scanMode` enum
- Added description reference for the fifth enum option
- Added command definition for `todo-tree.scanGitBranch` with `$(git-branch)` icon
- Added menu entries for the toolbar button cycle (current file → git branch → workspace)
- Added context menu entry for selecting git branch mode

**3. `package.nls.json`**
- Added `"todo-tree.command.scanGitBranch.title": "Scan Git Branch"`
- Added `"todo-tree.configuration.tree.scanMode.markdownEnumDescriptions.5"` description

**4. `package.nls.zh-cn.json`**
- Added Chinese translations for the new strings

### How It Works:
1. When "git branch" scan mode is selected, `rebuild()` calls `searchGitBranch()` for each workspace folder
2. `getBaseBranch()` determines if `main` or `master` should be used as the base
3. `searchGitBranch()` runs `git diff main..HEAD --unified=0` and parses the output
4. Only lines starting with `+` (added lines) are searched for TODOs
5. Results are added to `searchResults` and displayed in the tree
